title: Download Wold / Fen
description: Download the Wold / Fen Android APK straight from this site. SHA-256 and signing fingerprint published alongside, so you can verify what you install.
lede: No store listing yet. Until there is one, this page is the only place we hand out the APK — so it publishes everything you need to check that what you downloaded is what we built.
verifyNote: **Compare the hash** after downloading — if it differs, do not install it. You can also verify the signature itself: apksigner verify -v (from the Android SDK build-tools).
mirrorTitle: Where else it will show up
mirrorNote: A GitHub Release mirror is planned for later. **This page stays authoritative** — if the two ever disagree, trust this hash.

channels.name: Official APK (sideload)
channels.desc: Grab the APK from this page and install it by hand. Android will ask permission to install from your browser - that prompt is the system being careful, not a warning about this file.
steps: Tap Download APK above and wait for the download to finish.
When Android asks, allow your browser to install unknown apps.
Open the downloaded file and install. Future updates arrive the same way: come back to this page.
channels.warn: **Signatures do not mix.** This package carries the official signing key. A build from any other channel carries a different key, and Android refuses to install one over the other. Pick one channel and stay with it - switching means uninstalling first, and local data does not survive that.

channels.name: F-Droid
channels.desc: F-Droid is a catalogue of free software. Every app in it is rebuilt from source and signed with the F-Droid repository key - so an F-Droid build of this app is a different signature from the one on this page, and the two cannot upgrade over each other either.
channels.warn: **Not submitted yet.** The listing will appear here once the source repository is public and the F-Droid team has reviewed the build recipe. Nothing on this page pretends the channel exists before it does.

channels.name: Build from source
channels.desc: The client is open source (MIT). Build it yourself and you never have to trust a binary from anyone - including us.
steps: Clone the repository and check out the release tag.
Run flutter pub get, then flutter build apk --release --flavor store.
Sign the result with your own key, or leave it unsigned for local testing.

versionFeedNote: The app checks **{feedUrl}** for update notices - the same version, hash and size as this page, in machine-readable form.
notReady: No APK is packaged for this release yet. Nothing here pretends otherwise — a download button that 404s would be worse than an honest empty page.
disclaimer: This is a self-distributed build, not a store release. Android will ask you to allow installs from this source; that warning is the operating system being careful, not evidence of anything wrong.
